description: Replace the full HTML email with a short text email and attach the health report as a PDF file generated via jsPDF in the Edge Function.
steps: Rewrite supabase/functions/send-health-report-email/index.ts to: (a) generate a PDF from report data using jsPDF via esm.sh, (b) send a short simple email body (2-3 lines), (c) attach the PDF using Resend's attachment support (base64 content + filename)

The PDF should include: REPGATE header with date range, user name, top stats, nutrition summary table, push-up discipline log table, most logged foods table, progress summary, weekly/monthly insight, footer disclaimer
The email body should be minimal - just a greeting, a line saying the report is ready/attached, and a motivational line
Use Resend attachments format: { filename, content (base64) }
acceptance_criteria: Email body is short (2-3 lines max, no full report data)
PDF is generated using jsPDF and attached to the email
PDF contains all report sections (nutrition, pushups, foods, progress, insight)
Resend API call includes attachments array with base64 PDF content
Edge Function compiles without errors under Deno
verification: deno check on the Edge Function passes
Read the file and verify email body is short
Verify jsPDF import and PDF generation logic exists
Verify Resend payload includes attachments field
findings: Rewrote send-health-report-email Edge Function. Email body is now 3 short lines (greeting, report attached note, motivational). PDF generated via jsPDF from esm.sh (https://esm.sh/jspdf@2.5.2). PDF includes all report sections with green-themed header, tables with alternating row backgrounds, and AI insight box. Resend attachments API used with base64 content. deno check passes cleanly.
